description: Activates a Content Autopilot task so it runs on its schedule, or deactivates it back to a draft. Use when the user wants to start, resume, pause or stop an automation. Not for one run now (use run_autopilot_task_now). Returns the task's status and next run. Activating takes one slot of the plan's active-automation limit; deactivating frees it and clears the next run.

action.description: activate = schedule the task (next run kept if in the future, else computed); deactivate = back to draft, no runs.

task_id.description: ID of the autopilot task. Get it from list_autopilot_tasks.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: set_autopilot_task_state
title: Turn content automation on or off
